architecture.runtime: Multi-host web container: browser, Electron, mobile WebView, kiosk WebView.
architecture.window: Native host windows are required; no window.open fallback for Window Manager.
architecture.repo: Monorepo; packages can later be published.
architecture.target: Modern browser / WebView; no SSR requirement.

event_bus.scope: Native SDK / Plugin / Flow / Window / UI unified event layer.
event_bus.dispatch: Async handler, error isolation, timeout, trace, dead-letter; no automatic retry in Event Bus v1.
event_bus.type_safety: Core events typed; plugin events extended through manifest and module augmentation.
event_bus.ordering: Guarantee same publisher + same topic order.
event_bus.cross_window: BroadcastChannelTransport first; native window transport added later.

flow.definition: TypeScript DSL primary; JSON schema import/export supported.
flow.execution: DAG flow; node can have internal state machine.
flow.start: Only explicit flowEngine.start(flowId, input); no automatic event/UI/plugin auto-start in v1.
flow.node_types: action / userInput / waitEvent / decision / parallel / race / subflow / compensation / terminal.
flow.effects: Direct ctx calls and effect-first both supported; effect-first recommended.
flow.timeout: Flow-level and node-level timeout; project preset default userInputTimeout; node override.
flow.interrupt: Flow-level interrupt policy with priority + node override + project default policy.
flow.versioning: Flow instance binds to start-time flow version; no v1 migration.
flow.trace: Summary by default; safeToLog fields opt-in.

logging.rolling: Daily rolling /logs/app_{{yyyyMMdd}}.log; 14 files; compression configurable default true.
logging.transports: dev console + native file; prod native file.
logging.fallback: If Native FS unavailable use console logger and publish logging.file.unavailable warning.
logging.mode: dev direct writes; prod queued writes.
logging.flush: Flush after error; close on shutdown.

tooling.build: tsup for packages, Vite for example/project app
